# CamelGraph v0.51.0: a review of the whole node library, and node packs that survive updates (personal-use edition with installer)

> **Personal use only.** This download (GitHub, bimcamel.com) is the free *Personal use* edition under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0: learning, hobby projects, research, and charities, schools, universities, public research bodies and government institutions. **For professional use** (work at a company, a consultancy or design office, a paid project or product) a copy for the **Autodesk App Store** is **coming soon**; it will come with a commercial licence from BIMCamel. It is the same program in both editions.

## What is new since 0.50.0

* **A review of the whole node library.** 210 findings (bugs, duplicates, gaps, nodes that did not work with lists, nodes that could break a node group) are fixed. The library has 589 nodes: 42 new names, 32 retired (hidden from the library, still loading and running, so saved graphs and the sample graphs keep working).
* **Node packs survive updates.** Packs are read from `%APPDATA%\CamelGraph\Packages` first, so an update or uninstall leaves them alone, then from the `Packages` folder beside the plug-in. **Help > Node Packs** says where packs go, what loaded and what did not (with the reason), and opens the folder. One bad pack no longer takes the others with it.
* **Expand all / collapse all in the node library** are a small plain + and -.
* **"Equal" and "sorted" mean one thing everywhere.** `Equals`, `Logic.Compare` and `Logic.Switch` ignore the case of text and read "5" as 5; lists and dictionaries are compared by content; every sort puts numbers by value and text ignoring case, with empty items last. An empty cell never passes a less-than or greater-than test any more, and a cell of text such as "TBC" next to a number no longer turns a whole filter red.
* **Lists, tables and spreadsheets with gaps work.** `Sum`, `Average`, `Median` and the other number nodes skip empty cells; a list with no numbers gives an empty result and a warning instead of a red error. `Table.Join` joins on several columns and no longer multiplies blank keys; `Table.Sort`, `Distinct`, `GroupBy` and `Join` take a list of column names.
* **Files behave.** Relative paths mean "next to the graph file"; the browse button opens a folder, Save or Open dialog as the node needs; writers say "writes files" before a graph from a file runs; text, CSV and Excel files read and write the right encoding, dates and codes such as 007; a writer with nothing wired no longer empties a file.
* **Node groups and loops are safer.** A false `Flow.When` inside a group only switches off what depends on it, a failed input only stops the nodes that need it, `Flow.Try` works across the group boundary, and Make Node Group keeps input, Watch and "Show in Player" nodes outside the group. Watch nodes cap what they draw on huge lists; `Workflow.ForEach` carries on after a bad item.
* **Clash, viewpoints, selection sets and TimeLiner.** `ClashTest.Create` no longer replaces a test of the same name silently; an empty list wired to `tests` means no tests; `Clash.Deduplicate` works across tests; `Viewpoint.Save` replaces two nodes and takes a folder path; `Search.ByProperty` takes a list of values and an `exists` mode; selection sets have folder nodes; `TimelinerTask.Create` updates instead of adding again.
* **New nodes:** `Dictionary.ValueAtPath`, `Table.SetColumn`, `Table.Unmatched`, `DateTime.Add`, `Difference`, `AddWorkdays`, `IsWeekend` and `FromExcelSerial`, `Math.IsClose`, `Directory.Find`, `Copy` and `Move`, `Web.Download`, `Path.Join`, `Graph.Folder`, `Flow.Require`, `IFC.IsGlobalId`, `IFC.Normalize`, `Clash.ResultsTable`, `Clash.FilterBySnapshot`, `ClashResult.ByGuid`, `Camera.Save` and `Restore`, `Properties.SetCustomFromTable` and more: the full list is in `CHANGELOG.md`.
* **For node pack authors:** `[AcceptsNull]`, `[ScalarInput]`, `[LiveState]`, `[NodePath]`, `NodeWarnings.Add`, `PathResolver` and the file-writing and model-changing flags are described in `docs/EXTENDING.md`.

Nothing in this release was tried inside Navisworks; `docs/QA_CHECKLIST.md` lists what to try.

Questions and problems: support@bimcamel.com, or the issue form on GitHub. The full list is in `CHANGELOG.md`.

Only Navisworks Manage 2024 has been seen running CamelGraph in the field; 2025, 2026 and Simulate are built and installed the same way but not yet confirmed. **Help > Run Self-Test** checks the nodes against your own model.
